name: 32712 · Apopka, FL
findings: ZIP 32712 (Apopka) has 138 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32712 (Apopka) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32712 (Apopka) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
